purpose: Evaluation-only color comparison. Decides exact / broader-family / unrelated / uncertainty for the primaryColor and secondaryColors fields.

sources.role: authoritative production shade -> family map. Imported verbatim; no entry added or removed.
second production color normalizer. Documented divergences below.

importedFamilyMap._comment: Imported verbatim from COLOR_FAMILY_MAP. shade -> broader family.

comparisonRules.exact: Normalized prediction equals normalized ground truth (after spelling-variant folding only).
comparisonRules.broader_family: Prediction is the FAMILY of the ground-truth shade. navy(GT) vs blue(pred) = one level broader = acceptably_broad.
comparisonRules.narrower: Prediction is a specific shade where ground truth is only the family. blue(GT) vs navy(pred) = NOT acceptably broad; scored unsupported_certainty because the model asserted a shade the label does not support.
comparisonRules.unrelated: Different families, or same-family peers that production keeps distinct.
comparisonRules.same_family_peers: navy vs cobalt share family 'blue' but are distinct shades. Scored unrelated, NOT acceptably_broad — one-level-broader means moving UP the hierarchy, never sideways.
comparisonRules.unknown: Uncertainty token on either side routes to the uncertainty rules in scoreFields, not to color comparison.
comparisonRules.multicolor: Treated as a terminal family with no children. multicolor vs any specific color is unrelated.

disputedMappings.problem: teal sits between blue and green. Neither production map assigns it a family: it is absent from COLOR_FAMILY_MAP and falls through normalizeColor unchanged.
disputedMappings.chosenRule: teal is treated as its OWN terminal family. It is never folded into blue or green. teal(GT) vs blue(pred) scores unrelated.
disputedMappings.rationale: Choosing blue or green would be an invented mapping. Treating it as terminal is the only option that does not fabricate a production relationship. Recorded explicitly rather than assumed, per the Phase 0B rule against undocumented ambiguous mappings.
disputedMappings.affectsBaseline: Only if a labeled case uses teal. No current case does.

disputedMappings.problem: Absent from COLOR_FAMILY_MAP. Commonly read as a green, but production also groups khaki -> brown, and olive/khaki are frequently conflated in apparel copy.
disputedMappings.chosenRule: olive is its own terminal family. Not folded into green or brown.
disputedMappings.rationale: Same as teal: no production evidence for either parent.

disputedMappings.status: RESOLVED but internally divergent in production
disputedMappings.problem: COLOR_FAMILY_MAP maps off-white -> white (family). CANONICAL_SEARCH_COLOR maps off-white -> ivory (canonical search form). normalizeColor in scanHelpers maps off-white -> 'white/cream' (a THIRD, slash-joined form).
disputedMappings.chosenRule: Evaluation uses the COLOR_FAMILY_MAP family relation off-white -> white. The slash-joined 'white/cream' form from normalizeColor is registered as a compound token that resolves to family white.
disputedMappings.rationale: COLOR_FAMILY_MAP is the map whose stated purpose is family membership. The other two serve search-query construction and display.

compoundProductionTokens._comment: normalizeColor emits slash-joined compound labels that are not single colors. Registered so they are not scored as unrelated strings.

unsupportedComparisons.reason: The V2 result exposes colors.primary and colors.secondary[]; the ordering of secondary colors is provider-dependent and not stable. Secondary color scoring is set-based, never order-based.
